development_data.name: General-AgentBench published baseline prompts
development_data.usage: Router V6 may fit on these development prompts only. No Router V2-V5 external holdout task is reused for V6 scoring.

sampling_rule: Load published WebArena task intents, compute SHA256(task_id + '\n' + intent), sort ascending by digest, and select the first 72. The rule is fixed before the first successful score.
label_visibility: The terminalbench family label is attached only after Router V5 and Router V6 predictions are produced.
primary_metric: Interactive-family Hit@1 over the 72-task WebArena holdout
secondary_metrics: Router V5 Hit@1 on the identical new holdout
anti_tuning_rule: After the first successful scored run, Router V6 algorithm, weights, source pin, sampling rule, and task count are frozen for this holdout. Any changed router must become Router V7 with a new holdout.
evidence_boundary: This is task-family routing transfer only. It does not claim native WebArena environment success, browser action correctness, or end-to-end task completion.
